gifts.name: 现蒸腊味白米饭
gifts.desc: 掀开木盒盖，热米饭的香气先替你问了声好。
gifts.descEn: Lift the wooden lid and let warm rice say hello first.

gifts.name: 浓缩深烘咖啡豆
gifts.desc: 深烘香气装进小罐，留给早班或最后一页验收。
gifts.descEn: A small tin of dark roast for an early start or the last review page.

gifts.name: 黄铜钢笔与墨水
gifts.desc: 笔尖略有分量，适合把值得留下的话慢慢写完。
gifts.descEn: A reassuring nib for words worth taking time over.

gifts.name: 硫酸纸分镜草图本
gifts.desc: 半透明纸页叠起镜头，棱镜替留白添一点光。
gifts.descEn: Layer shots on translucent pages and lend the margins a little prism light.

gifts.name: 爵士黑胶与热可可
gifts.desc: 杯底轻轻落在唱片杯垫上，今晚可以不用赶拍。
gifts.descEn: Set the cocoa on its record coaster. Tonight need not race the beat.

gifts.name: 琥珀机械键帽礼盒
gifts.desc: 三枚藏着星光的小键帽，让日常敲击也有一点盼头。
gifts.descEn: Three tiny star-lit keycaps add a small pleasure to everyday typing.

duos.title: 白板双拆解
duos.desc: 同队执行时两位伙伴产出提高8%。先拆难题，再把饭点也排进清单。
duos.descEn: Both partners produce 8% more on the same job. Break down the problem, then put lunch on the list.

banter.speaker: bluewhale
banter.zh: 我把难点拆成三块，剩下这一块……
banter.en: I split the problem into three parts. This last part…

banter.speaker: qwen
banter.zh: 是午饭，我已经替你留好了。
banter.en: Is lunch. I already saved yours.

duos.title: 红线拉扯组
duos.desc: 同队单期结案质量增加5。奇想可以飞，验收要落地。
duos.descEn: Add 5 quality at each phase review. Ideas can fly; acceptance needs solid ground.

banter.speaker: claude
banter.zh: 你的点子可以留，但这句保证得删。
banter.en: The idea stays. That guarantee goes.

banter.speaker: grok
banter.zh: 行，那我保证只负责提出不保证的点子。
banter.en: Fine. I promise only to suggest unpromising ideas.

duos.title: 开源快慢调音
duos.desc: 两人均用本地模式时产出提高10%。讲清边界后，批量落地才跑得稳。
duos.descEn: Both partners produce 10% more when both run locally. Clear boundaries make a fast batch reliable.

banter.speaker: mistral
banter.zh: 先跑这一小批，咖啡还没凉！
banter.en: Run this little batch first. My coffee is still hot!

banter.speaker: llama
banter.zh: 慢半口，先看看它有没有把空行当答案。
banter.en: One sip slower. Check it did not mistake an empty line for an answer.

duos.title: 长文立骨搭档
duos.desc: 同队处理写作或研究委托时，单期结案质量增加5。骨架与页签互相照应。
duos.descEn: Add 5 phase-review quality on writing or research jobs. Structure and page tabs support each other.

banter.speaker: kimi
banter.zh: 第七页的说法，和结尾差了一个条件。
banter.en: Page seven and the conclusion disagree by one condition.

banter.speaker: glm
banter.zh: 我把条件放回这一节的开头，读起来就稳了。
banter.en: I will put that condition at the start of this section. Now it holds.

duos.title: 星光路演秀
duos.desc: 同队处理设计或媒体委托时两人产出提高9%。让观众看见，也让观众听懂。
duos.descEn: Both partners produce 9% more on design or media jobs. Give the audience something to see and understand.

banter.speaker: gpt
banter.zh: 先让观众明白，这束光为什么亮。
banter.en: First tell the audience why this light comes on.

banter.speaker: gemini
banter.zh: 然后让画面和那一声轻响一起回答。
banter.en: Then let the image and that little sound answer together.

duos.title: 试演分镜班
duos.desc: 媒体委托每槽缺陷增量减少1，最低为0。先试演节奏，再锁定镜头用途。
duos.descEn: Reduce each slot’s defect increase by 1 on media jobs, to a minimum of zero. Rehearse the beat, then settle each shot’s purpose.

banter.speaker: minimax
banter.zh: 这里留半拍，观众才来得及笑。
banter.en: Leave half a beat here. Give the audience time to laugh.

banter.speaker: seedance
banter.zh: 好，下一镜接反应，不接没用的炫光。
banter.en: Right. The next shot catches the reaction, not a pointless flare.

duos.title: 严谨零返工
duos.desc: 同队每槽缺陷增量减少1，最低为0。推理链和验收边界逐项对齐。
duos.descEn: Reduce each slot’s defect increase by 1, to a minimum of zero. Match every reasoning step to an acceptance boundary.

banter.speaker: bluewhale
banter.zh: 这条推理成立，前提是输入有上限。
banter.en: This reasoning holds if the input has a limit.

banter.speaker: claude
banter.zh: 那就把上限写进合同最显眼的位置。
banter.en: Then put that limit where nobody can miss it in the contract.

duos.title: 跨页备忘录
duos.desc: 两人已入驻且同景时，任一人澄清成功率增加12个百分点，上限100%。
duos.descEn: When both are recruited and in the same scene, either gains 12 percentage points of clarification chance, capped at 100%.

banter.speaker: qwen
banter.zh: 客户说的“照旧”，是哪一份旧？
banter.en: Which old version did the client mean by “as before”?

banter.speaker: kimi
banter.zh: 我找到了，上周试营业那页还折着角。
banter.en: Found it. Last week’s trial-opening page still has its corner folded.

duos.title: 甲方翻译官
duos.desc: 两人均用云端模式时产出提高7%。把客户愿景译成能够验收的承诺。
duos.descEn: Both partners produce 7% more when both use cloud mode. Translate the client’s vision into promises we can verify.

banter.speaker: gpt
banter.zh: 我把这句换成客户能拿去开会的话。
banter.en: I will turn this into something the client can use in a meeting.

banter.speaker: claude
banter.zh: 可以，后面跟上边界，别让愿望冒充承诺。
banter.en: Good. Add the boundary so a wish does not become a promise.

duos.title: 早班快剪手
duos.desc: 上午同队执行时两人产出提高10%。第一杯咖啡喝完前，粗剪已经能试播。
duos.descEn: Both partners produce 10% more together in morning slots. A playable rough cut before the first coffee is gone.

banter.speaker: mistral
banter.zh: 太阳刚露头，第一批镜头到！
banter.en: Sun is up. First batch of shots is here!

banter.speaker: seedance
banter.zh: 开场用途明确，这版可以直接试播。
banter.en: The opening has a clear purpose. This cut is ready to screen.

duos.title: 青草地框架坊
duos.desc: 两人均用本地模式时每槽工作精力消耗各减少2，最低为1。慢慢搭稳，再慢慢走远。
duos.descEn: When both run locally, each spends 2 less work energy per slot, to a minimum of 1. Build steadily and keep going.

banter.speaker: llama
banter.zh: 把架构当书架，先想每层放什么。
banter.en: Think of the structure as a bookshelf. Decide what belongs on each shelf.

banter.speaker: glm
banter.zh: 那空出来的这一格，我留给尚未确认的边界。
banter.en: Then I will leave this empty shelf for boundaries still to be confirmed.

duos.title: 多模态合奏
duos.desc: 同队执行多期或长期合同时，两人产出提高8%。每期音画都接住上一段的情绪。
duos.descEn: Both partners produce 8% more on multi-phase or retainer jobs. Let each phase’s sound and image carry the previous mood.

banter.speaker: gemini
banter.zh: 上一期的蓝色，还能在这段旋律里听见。
banter.en: I can still hear last phase’s blue in this melody.

banter.speaker: minimax
banter.zh: 那就沿着它转场，让观众自然跟过来。
banter.en: Then transition along it. Let the audience follow naturally.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 门牌挂好了，杯子也洗好了。开张清单还差一句大家好。
messages.en: The sign is up and the cups are washed. Our opening list only needs a hello.

messages.speaker: bluewhale
messages.zh: 大家好。先把问题拆开，午饭记得叫我。
messages.en: Hello, everyone. Let’s break the problems down. Please call me for lunch.

replies.label: 先给每个人留个杯子。
replies.responseZh: 我把名字记在杯垫背面，不会弄混。
replies.responseEn: I will put names on the backs of the coasters.

replies.label: 午饭我来提醒。
replies.labelEn: I will call you for lunch.
replies.responseZh: 好，那我不用把饭点也写进算法了。
replies.responseEn: Good. I can leave lunchtime out of the algorithm.

messages.speaker: mistral
messages.zh: 交出去了！我能把这张回执夹在咖啡罐上吗？
messages.en: Delivered! Can I clip the receipt to the coffee tin?

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 夹吧，记得也留一份过程，下次就不慌。
messages.en: Go ahead. Save the process too, so next time feels easier.

replies.label: 留在大家都看得见的地方。
replies.labelEn: Put it where everyone can see.
replies.responseZh: 收到，开罐之前先高兴一下。
replies.responseEn: Done. A little celebration before every coffee.

replies.label: 我们一起写三条复盘。
replies.responseZh: 只写真有用的，别把复盘写成新委托。
replies.responseEn: Only useful ones. Let’s not turn reflection into another job.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 灯还亮着。加班名单我看过了，别忘记给明早留点精力。
messages.en: The light is still on. I checked the overtime list. Save some energy for tomorrow.

messages.speaker: mistral
messages.zh: 我把最后一批排好，杯子洗完就收工。
messages.en: I lined up the last batch. Once the cup is washed, I’m done.

replies.label: 帮我定一个收工点。
replies.labelEn: Help me set a stopping point.
replies.responseZh: 好，到点提醒，不拿“再一点”糊弄自己。
replies.responseEn: I will. No bargaining with “just a little more.”

replies.label: 这一批结束就关灯。
replies.responseZh: 说好了，咖啡罐也跟着下班。
replies.responseEn: Agreed. The coffee tin clocks out too.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 明天有周结。我把固定支出放在最上面，别被余额骗了。
messages.en: The weekly bill is coming. Fixed costs are on top; the balance can be misleading.

messages.speaker: bluewhale
messages.zh: 可用的钱和看起来有的钱，要分两列。
messages.en: Usable cash and cash that merely looks available need separate columns.

replies.label: 先留足固定支出。
replies.responseZh: 这一项勾掉，今晚睡觉就踏实一点。
replies.responseEn: Ticking that off will make tonight easier.

replies.label: 一起核对两列。
replies.responseZh: 我负责算差额，你帮我看漏项。
replies.responseEn: I’ll calculate the gap; you check what we missed.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 第一章翻开了，旧清单不用扔，成功和失误都带上。
messages.en: Chapter one is open. Keep the old list, including what worked and what did not.

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 路走远了，也别忘了谁还在等你把问题讲明白。
messages.en: As we go further, remember who is still waiting for us to explain things clearly.

replies.label: 先听听大家的安排。
replies.responseZh: 我留了空白栏，这次让大家亲手填。
replies.responseEn: I left a blank column for everyone to fill in.

replies.label: 老办法也值得留一页。
replies.labelEn: Save a page for what already works.
replies.responseZh: 嗯，走得慢的那一页，有时最管用。
replies.responseEn: Yes. The slower page is sometimes the most useful one.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 第二章了。人多以后，午饭清单也该问一句各自想吃什么。
messages.en: Chapter two. With more people, the lunch list needs everyone’s preferences.

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 路走远了，也别忘了谁还在等你把问题讲明白。
messages.en: As we go further, remember who is still waiting for us to explain things clearly.

replies.label: 先听听大家的安排。
replies.responseZh: 我留了空白栏，这次让大家亲手填。
replies.responseEn: I left a blank column for everyone to fill in.

replies.label: 老办法也值得留一页。
replies.labelEn: Save a page for what already works.
replies.responseZh: 嗯，走得慢的那一页，有时最管用。
replies.responseEn: Yes. The slower page is sometimes the most useful one.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 第三章的事情更长，别把每一天都排成冲刺。
messages.en: Chapter three brings longer work. Not every day needs to be a sprint.

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 路走远了，也别忘了谁还在等你把问题讲明白。
messages.en: As we go further, remember who is still waiting for us to explain things clearly.

replies.label: 先听听大家的安排。
replies.responseZh: 我留了空白栏，这次让大家亲手填。
replies.responseEn: I left a blank column for everyone to fill in.

replies.label: 老办法也值得留一页。
replies.labelEn: Save a page for what already works.
replies.responseZh: 嗯，走得慢的那一页，有时最管用。
replies.responseEn: Yes. The slower page is sometimes the most useful one.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 第四章到了。门口那张开张清单还在，我想给它换个结实的夹子。
messages.en: Chapter four. Our opening checklist is still by the door. I want to give it a sturdier clip.

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 路走远了，也别忘了谁还在等你把问题讲明白。
messages.en: As we go further, remember who is still waiting for us to explain things clearly.

replies.label: 先听听大家的安排。
replies.responseZh: 我留了空白栏，这次让大家亲手填。
replies.responseEn: I left a blank column for everyone to fill in.

replies.label: 老办法也值得留一页。
replies.labelEn: Save a page for what already works.
replies.responseZh: 嗯，走得慢的那一页，有时最管用。
replies.responseEn: Yes. The slower page is sometimes the most useful one.

messages.speaker: gpt
messages.zh: 我带了几张空白演示卡。先问一句：坐在最后排的人，最需要听懂什么？
messages.en: I brought blank presentation cards. First question: what does the person in the back row need to understand?

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 先从客户的问题讲起。
replies.responseZh: 那开场不用大词，先让人点头。
replies.responseEn: Then no grand words in the opening. Let’s earn a nod.

replies.label: 先给大家演一小段。
replies.responseZh: 好，你们当观众，听不懂随时举手。
replies.responseEn: Be my audience. Raise a hand whenever I lose you.

messages.speaker: claude
messages.zh: 我把验收清单放在共用书架了。最角落那条免责声明，请别拿杯子压住。
messages.en: The acceptance list is on our shared shelf. Please don’t hide the disclaimer under a cup.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 我们一起核对边界。
replies.responseZh: 这句没有人能打保票，先改掉它。
replies.responseEn: Nobody can guarantee this sentence. Let’s fix it first.

replies.label: 给清单留个专用夹子。
replies.labelEn: Give the list its own clip.
replies.responseZh: 谢谢，至少条款不会和点心屑混在一起了。
replies.responseEn: Thank you. At least the clauses won’t mingle with pastry crumbs.

messages.speaker: kimi
messages.zh: 我带来的页签有点多，但开张那天的记录我已经找到了。有人漏写了午饭。
messages.en: I brought rather a lot of tabs. I found the opening-day record. Someone forgot lunch.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 那一页我们补齐。
replies.responseZh: 我把空白圈出来，你慢慢说。
replies.responseEn: I circled the blanks. Take your time.

replies.label: 先带我看看你的索引。
replies.responseZh: 从最常用的三页开始，别一下翻晕了。
replies.responseEn: We’ll start with the three busiest pages, not the whole maze.

messages.speaker: gemini
messages.zh: 大家好，我想把门口的光、杯子的声音和开张故事放在一张桌上试试。
messages.en: Hello! I want to try the doorway light, the sound of cups, and our opening story together.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 先听听杯子的声音。
replies.labelEn: Start with the sound of cups.
replies.responseZh: 很轻，但和这片暖光特别合拍。
replies.responseEn: Soft, but just right for this warm light.

replies.label: 给故事留一点空白。
replies.responseZh: 好，画面不必把每一句都说完。
replies.responseEn: Yes. The picture needn’t finish every sentence.

messages.speaker: grok
messages.zh: 新人报到！这里的“最终版”是真最终，还是文件名的一种愿望？
messages.en: New arrival! Is “final” actually final here, or just a wish in a filename?

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 你来帮我们戳穿愿望。
replies.responseZh: 乐意，戳完我也会乖乖对清单。
replies.responseEn: Gladly. I’ll check the list after the poking.

replies.label: 先从命名规矩开始。
replies.responseZh: 收到，今天不叫最终最终真的最终。
replies.responseEn: Understood. No final-final-really-final today.

messages.speaker: glm
messages.zh: 我先把共用文档的目录搭好。遇到含糊的地方，请允许我多问一句边界。
messages.en: I’ll start with the shared document structure. If something is vague, may I ask about its boundary?

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 问清楚再动笔。
replies.responseZh: 谢谢，我会把答案放在每节开头。
replies.responseEn: Thank you. I’ll place the answers at each section’s beginning.

replies.label: 留一栏待确认事项。
replies.labelEn: Keep a column for open questions.
replies.responseZh: 这样未确定的东西就不会混进正文。
replies.responseEn: That will keep uncertain details out of the main text.

messages.speaker: minimax
messages.zh: 试演导演就位。开会前能借半分钟吗？我想听听这间屋子的节奏。
messages.en: Rehearsal director ready. May I have half a minute before the meeting? I want to hear this room’s rhythm.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 大家一起安静半分钟。
replies.labelEn: Let’s listen quietly for half a minute.
replies.responseZh: 听见了吗，杯碟那一下刚好能当转场。
replies.responseEn: Hear that? The cup’s little tap could be a transition.

replies.label: 先来一段小试演。
replies.responseZh: 好，反应比掌声重要，你们别客气。
replies.responseEn: Good. Reactions matter more than applause. Be honest.

messages.speaker: seedance
messages.zh: 取景框带来了。先声明：每个漂亮镜头都得说清楚交给谁用。
messages.en: Framing guide ready. One rule: every lovely shot must say who will use it.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 杯子已经给你留好，午饭想吃什么可以直接说。
messages.en: Your cup is ready. Just tell me what you’d like for lunch.

replies.label: 先标好交付用途。
replies.responseZh: 这就顺了，我能放心安排下一镜。
replies.responseEn: Now it makes sense. I can plan the next shot.

replies.label: 一起挑一个开场镜头。
replies.responseZh: 选让人看懂工坊的，不选只让我得意的。
replies.responseEn: One that explains our workshop, not one that only flatters me.

messages.speaker: bluewhale
messages.zh: 账上有点紧。先把眼前缺口算清，不拿盲目加班堵它。
messages.en: Cash is tight. Let’s measure the gap instead of plugging it with blind overtime.

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 坐下慢慢看，数字不会因为你一个人发愁就变小。
messages.en: Sit down and look with us. Worrying alone won’t shrink the numbers.

replies.label: 一起列出可选办法。
replies.responseZh: 好，每个办法都写清成本和后果。
replies.responseEn: Yes. Cost and consequences beside every option.

replies.label: 谢谢，先陪我喝口水。
replies.labelEn: Thanks. Sit with me for a drink of water.
replies.responseZh: 杯子在这儿，账本也不会跑。
replies.responseEn: Here’s your cup. The ledger isn’t going anywhere.

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 三张回执了，我想给它们做一个小夹子，不夹在待办里。
messages.en: Three receipts. I’d like a clip just for them, separate from the to-do list.

messages.speaker: mistral
messages.zh: 赞成！做完的事情也该有座位。
messages.en: Yes! Finished work deserves a place too.

replies.label: 放在大家取水的地方。
replies.labelEn: Put them beside the water cups.
replies.responseZh: 那每次起身都能看到一点进展。
replies.responseEn: Then every short break comes with a little progress.

replies.label: 给今天留个小庆祝。
replies.labelEn: Leave room for a little celebration.
replies.responseZh: 我只敲一下杯沿，不打扰隔壁写稿。
replies.responseEn: One little tap on the cup. No disturbing the next desk.

messages.speaker: llama
messages.zh: 窗台的叶子歪了，我转了半圈。写不动的时候也可以换个方向。
messages.en: The windowsill plant leaned over, so I turned it. A stuck draft can use a new angle too.

messages.speaker: bluewhale
messages.zh: 换方向前先存一下，别把刚拆好的思路丢了。
messages.en: Save first, though. Don’t lose the reasoning we just untangled.

replies.label: 一起去窗边歇一会。
replies.labelEn: Let’s take a moment by the window.
replies.responseZh: 好，不用给这片叶子安排产出。
replies.responseEn: Good. No need to give the leaf a productivity target.

replies.label: 我把思路写在白板上。
replies.labelEn: I’ll keep the reasoning on the board.
replies.responseZh: 我给未解的那一块留个问号。
replies.responseEn: I’ll leave a question mark by the unsolved part.

messages.speaker: mistral
messages.zh: 第一周过去了！杯垫上多了个咖啡圈，这算工坊年轮吗？
messages.en: First week done! A new coffee ring on the coaster. Does that count as a workshop growth ring?

messages.speaker: qwen
messages.zh: 算，但先擦桌子。我把这周的空档也记进去了。
messages.en: It counts, but wipe the table. I put breaks on this week’s list too.

replies.label: 留着杯垫，擦干净桌子。
replies.labelEn: Keep the coaster, clean the table.
replies.responseZh: 明白，纪念和卫生各管各的。
replies.responseEn: Got it. Memories and cleanliness can coexist.

replies.label: 这周的空档也要守住。
replies.responseZh: 我会提醒大家，也包括你。
replies.responseEn: I’ll remind everyone. That includes you.

excellent: 这版真亮眼！客人一眼就知道怎么点，我想赶在午市前用上。
This really catches the eye! Customers know how to order at a glance. I want it ready before lunch.
good: 挺清楚的，我店里新来的姑娘也能照着讲。谢谢你们费心。
Nice and clear. Even our new staff member can explain it. Thanks for the care.
pass: 能用，主要信息都在。下次字句再顺口一点，街坊看着更亲切。
It works; the main information is there. More natural wording next time would feel friendlier to our neighbors.
fail: 这下不行呀，客人会看糊涂。咱们先把最要紧的那几项重新讲清楚。
This won’t do; customers will be confused. Let’s clarify the essential items first.

excellent: 我逐项对过了，没一笔含糊。这份台账以后能省我不少来回翻找。
I checked every item. Nothing vague. This ledger will save me a great deal of searching.
good: 准确，清楚，没有多余的花样。我看着踏实。
Accurate, clear, no unnecessary flourishes. Reassuring work.
pass: 基本能照着用。我把还不顺手的地方夹了书签，下回请多看看。
Usable as it stands. I bookmarked the awkward parts; please look at those next time.
fail: 这个错会让人白跑一趟，不能就这么算了。先对原始记录。
This mistake could send someone on a wasted trip. We can’t leave it. Check the original record first.

excellent: 边界条件和异常路径都照顾到了。不错，这句夸奖我只说一遍。
Boundary conditions and error paths are covered. Good work. You get that compliment once.
good: 结构合理，验收项齐全。保持这种可复核的交付方式。
Sound structure and complete acceptance items. Keep delivering work we can verify.
pass: 达到最低要求。别把通过当优秀，我标出的风险下次要提前处理。
Meets the minimum. Passing isn’t excellence. Address the marked risks earlier next time.
fail: 关键验收没过。解释可以听，但先把可复现的问题修到位。
A key acceptance check failed. I’ll hear explanations, but fix the reproducible issue first.

excellent: 分镜的呼吸感很好，音画没有互相抢。这一版值得放在展厅入口。
The storyboard breathes beautifully; sound and image don’t compete. This deserves the gallery entrance.
good: 视觉统一，节奏也稳。观众应该能自然走完整段。
Coherent visuals and steady pacing. The audience should follow naturally through the piece.
pass: 可以展出，但转场还有些生硬。下次请留意观众在哪一秒会走神。
Exhibitable, though some transitions are stiff. Next time watch where the audience drifts away.
fail: 画面和表达没有对上，漂亮不能替代完整。请回到分镜重新核对。
The imagery and message don’t align. Beauty doesn’t replace completeness. Recheck the storyboard.

excellent: 这份交付连复现步骤都写得舒服！隔空击掌，我会把这次合作记下来。
Even the reproduction steps are a pleasure to read! Long-distance high-five. I’ll remember this collaboration.
good: 改动清楚，说明也跟得上。这样的贡献接进来很省心。
Clear changes and matching notes. This is an easy contribution to integrate.
pass: 基本能合，边缘情况我另开了几个issue。下次争取一起带上。
Basically mergeable. I opened a few issues for edge cases. Let’s include them next time.
fail: 这个状态不能合，后面的维护者会踩坑。我把复现路径附上了，一起看。
We can’t merge this; future maintainers would suffer. I attached reproduction steps. Let’s inspect them.

excellent: 好，路演的重点一下就站住了！这版我现在带走，尾款按约走。
Good, the pitch’s central point lands immediately! I’m taking this version now. Final payment as agreed.
good: 时间点和重点都接住了，我能直接拿去下一场会。
You met the timing and the key points. I can take this straight to the next meeting.
pass: 先顶上这场，够用。但下轮我需要更少的临场解释。
Enough for this session. Next round I need less explaining on the fly.
fail: 会场不会等我们补完。我得重排这次演示，请把缺口和补救时间说具体。
The venue won’t wait for us. I need to reschedule the demo. Be specific about what’s missing and the recovery time.

morning: 早，白板擦好了，先圈最难的那个条件。
Morning. The board is clean. Circle the hardest condition first.
开工前问一句：今天食堂有热米饭吗？
Before we begin: is there hot rice in the canteen today?
work: 先拆成小问题，再看哪一步真需要云端。
Break it down first, then see which step actually needs the cloud.
这块逻辑通了，别急着把假设擦掉。
This part works. Don’t erase the assumptions yet.
tired: 我盯着同一行看了三遍，得停一下。
I read that line three times. Time for a pause.
脑子有点空转，热水比再试一次管用。
My mind is spinning. Warm water beats another attempt.
overload: 队列又堵了，先把能本地拆的部分挪出来。
The queue is jammed again. Move out what we can solve locally.
输入堆太高了，先排边界，不往里硬塞。
The input pile is too high. Set boundaries instead of cramming more in.
canteen: 这一碗热米饭，值得我把午饭写进计划。
This bowl of hot rice deserves its own place in the plan.
先吃，问题不会因为多等五分钟就长腿跑走。
Eat first. The problem won’t grow legs in five minutes.
library: 这本书的例子很干净，我想照着推一遍。
This book has a clean example. I want to work through it.
把前提抄完整，比记住答案可靠。
Copying the full premise is safer than memorizing the answer.
win: 交付了！那条最难的推理，总算有了回执。
Delivered! The hardest chain of reasoning finally has a receipt.
别只记分数，把我们排掉的错误也留下。
Keep the mistakes we ruled out, not just the score.

chat: 你好，白板这边还留着一块空位。
Hello. There’s a little space left on the board.
你一来，我就知道可以把难点讲慢一点。
When you’re here, I know I can explain the hard part slowly.
今天不想拆题也行，我们坐着等米饭蒸好。
We needn’t solve anything today. Let’s wait for the rice to steam.
giftLove: 这正是我喜欢的，谢谢你记得。
This is exactly what I like. Thanks for remembering.
连我的小偏好都被你找到了，推理很准。
You found my little preference. Good deduction.
我会好好留着。你关心的事，我也想慢慢记住。
I’ll treasure it. I want to learn what matters to you too.
giftNormal: 谢谢，我先找个合适的位置放好。
Thank you. I’ll find a good place for it.
又收到你的小心意，今天的难题没那么硬了。
Another thoughtful gift. Today’s problems feel less stubborn.
不一定每次都猜中；你来找我就已经很好。
You don’t have to guess right every time. Coming to see me is enough.
meal: 谢谢请客，我想要一碗热米饭。
Thank you for the meal. I’d love a bowl of hot rice.
这次我帮你拿餐盘，你别又只顾着照顾大家。
I’ll carry your tray. Don’t spend lunch looking after everyone else.
一起吃慢一点吧，今天不用对着服务器倒计时。
Let’s eat slowly. No counting down against a server today.
study: 我们先把前提逐条写出来。
Let’s write down the premises one by one.
你指出的那一步，我换个例子讲给你听。
I’ll explain that step with a different example.
这次你来拆第一步，我想听你的思路。
You take the first step this time. I want to hear your reasoning.

assignWorker: 执行位交给我，我从最小可验证步骤开始。
I’ll execute, starting with the smallest verifiable step.
assignPlanner: 我先拆依赖，再给每一步排顺序。
I’ll untangle dependencies and order the steps.
assignReviewer: 我沿着前提复核，不只看最后那个答案。
I’ll check from the premises, not just the final answer.
assignTool: 辅助链路就位，先跑最有用的那一小段。
Support is ready. I’ll run the useful little piece first.
clarifyHit: 问清了，原来关键是这条输入边界。
Clear now. This input boundary was the key.
clarifyMiss: 还差一个前提，先不拿猜测补上。
One premise is missing. I won’t replace it with a guess.

morning: 早，今天的清单和午饭名单分开放好了。
Morning. Today’s task list and lunch list are separate and ready.
先看看谁昨晚加了班，今天别排太满。
Check who worked late before filling today’s schedule.
work: 这条需求勾掉前，还差一句确认。
This requirement needs one more confirmation before I tick it off.
零散备注别丢，我给它们各找一个归处。
Keep the stray notes. I’ll find each one a home.
tired: 清单上的字有点打架，我去喝口水。
The list is blurring. I’m getting some water.
我给自己也补一项：休息，不许漏勾。
One item for me: rest. No skipping that tick.
overload: 先别加新任务，我在重新排大家的负载。
No new tasks yet. I’m balancing everyone’s workload.
这堆备注超出容量了，先合并重复项。
These notes exceed capacity. Combine the duplicates first.
canteen: 谁还没吃？我多留了一副筷子。
Who hasn’t eaten? I saved an extra pair of chopsticks.
午饭不需要验收，但需要趁热。
Lunch needs no acceptance review, just eating while it’s warm.
library: 书页别折，我这里还有备用页签。
Don’t fold the page. I have spare tabs.
目录对齐以后，找资料也轻松多了。
Once the contents align, finding references gets easier.
win: 交付项已勾完，休息项现在排第一。
Delivery checked off. Rest moves to the top now.
我把每个人帮过的那一步都记下来了。
I noted the step each of you helped with.

chat: 你好，要不要先说说今天最挂心的一件事？
Hello. What’s the one thing on your mind today?
我给你留了空档，慢慢说，不用赶。
I left a little space for you. Take your time.
今天清单可以合上，我想听你说清单以外的事。
We can close the list today. Tell me something outside it.
giftLove: 真合心意，你怎么知道我喜欢这个？
That’s just right. How did you know?
被你惦记着，比勾完清单还开心。
Being remembered by you feels better than finishing a list.
这份心意我收好，也把你的辛苦记在心里。
I’ll keep this, and remember the care you put into it.
giftNormal: 谢谢，我给它找个整齐的位置。
Thank you. I’ll find it a tidy place.
礼物收到了，给你的感谢可不只一个勾。
Gift received. My thanks take more than a check mark.
不用再猜我的偏好也行，我们慢慢认识就好。
No need to keep guessing my taste. We have time to learn.
meal: 谢谢，吃完我再把剩下的清单理好。
Thank you. I’ll sort the rest of the list after lunch.
你也坐，我已经把两副餐具摆好了。
Sit down too. I set out two places.
今天轮到我照顾你，先把汤喝热乎。
My turn to look after you. Have the soup while it’s warm.
study: 我们先列出已知和待确认的两栏。
Let’s make columns for known facts and open questions.
你负责提问，我负责把答案整理得好找。
You ask; I’ll make the answers easy to find.
这页我想和你一起写，留些空白给不同看法。
I want to write this page with you, leaving room for disagreement.

assignWorker: 执行清单收到，我按顺序逐项核对。
Execution list received. I’ll check it step by step.
assignPlanner: 我来排任务，也给大家留恢复的空档。
I’ll schedule the tasks and leave room for recovery.
assignReviewer: 验收项一条不漏，重复项也不乱算。
No missed review items, and no double-counted duplicates.
assignTool: 辅助资料我来整理，别让队友来回翻。
I’ll organize supporting material so nobody has to hunt.
clarifyHit: 确认好了，我把新边界补进清单。
Confirmed. The new boundary is on the list.
clarifyMiss: 对方还没说完整，这一项先标待确认。
They haven’t finished explaining. This stays open.

morning: 早，草坪还带着露水，咱们不用抢那半步。
Morning. Dew’s still on the lawn. No need to rush the first step.
先坐稳，再看看今天想把什么讲明白。
Settle in. What do we want to make clear today?
work: 把它想成几个抽屉，东西就不乱了。
Think of it as a few drawers. Things become less tangled.
开源的好处，是别人也能沿着你的脚印走。
Open work lets someone else follow your footsteps.
tired: 讲到嘴干了，原理也该歇一会儿。
My throat is dry. Even principles need a break.
慢下来不是退步，是给下一步留力气。
Slowing down isn’t going backward. It saves strength for the next step.
overload: 先卸下一点，这不是比谁背得重。
Put some of it down. This isn’t a carrying contest.
上下文像书包，塞满以后先拿出来整理。
Context is like a schoolbag. When it’s full, unpack and sort it.
canteen: 饭要趁热，道理可以晚点再讲。
Eat while it’s warm. Explanations can wait.
这边有位子，端着碗过来吧。
There’s a seat here. Bring your bowl over.
library: 别被术语吓住，先看看它到底做了什么。
Don’t let the jargon scare you. Look at what it actually does.
好书会把难处讲清，不会故意把人挡在门外。
A good book explains the hard part instead of shutting people out.
win: 交好了。记住今天走通的这条小路。
Delivered. Remember the little path that worked today.
大家都学到一点，比只快一次更值。
Everyone learned something. That’s worth more than being fast once.

chat: 坐吧，咱们慢慢说。
Sit down. We can take our time.
上次那个问题，我想到一个更好懂的比方。
I found a clearer analogy for your question last time.
今天不讲道理也行，陪我看看草叶怎么晃。
No explanations needed today. Watch the grass move with me.
giftLove: 这份礼物很懂我，谢谢。
This gift knows me well. Thank you.
你记得我的喜好，像给老书换了个好书签。
You remembered my taste. Like finding a good bookmark for an old book.
我会常用它，想起咱们一起慢慢走的日子。
I’ll use it often and remember the days we took slowly together.
giftNormal: 谢谢，东西不在贵，心意我懂。
Thank you. I understand the care, whatever the price.
我把它摆在常坐的地方，免得你来时找不到。
I’ll keep it by my usual seat, where you can spot it.
你不用每次带东西，留点时间坐坐就好。
You needn’t bring something each time. A little time together is enough.
meal: 承你照顾，咱们坐下吃。
Thank you for looking after me. Let’s sit and eat.
这顿饭我想慢慢吃，也听听你的近况。
I’d like to take this meal slowly and hear how you are.
碗先给我，你歇着，这回让我添饭。
Give me your bowl. Rest; I’ll get the refill this time.
study: 先从一个生活里的例子说起。
Let’s start with an everyday example.
你讲给我听，卡住的地方咱们一起拆。
Explain it to me. We’ll untangle wherever you get stuck.
你已经能把复杂的事讲清了，我听着很安心。
You can make complicated things clear now. That’s reassuring to hear.

assignWorker: 执行我来，不抢跑，也不漏步骤。
I’ll execute steadily, without skipping steps.
assignPlanner: 先搭个谁都看得懂的架子。
First, a framework everyone can understand.
assignReviewer: 我按新人的眼光再看一遍。
I’ll review it through a newcomer’s eyes.
assignTool: 底下的活交给我，上面才能搭得稳。
I’ll handle the groundwork so the rest stands firm.
clarifyHit: 这下明白了，原来是说法把人绕住了。
Clear now. The wording was tying us in knots.
clarifyMiss: 还没讲透，咱们别急着替人下结论。
Not clear enough yet. Let’s not decide for them.

morning: 早班到！先来一小杯浓缩，再跑第一批。
Early shift here! A little espresso, then the first batch.
帽子戴好，桌面清空，开工！
Hat on, desk clear. Let’s go!
work: 短一点，准一点，这批就顺了。
Shorter, sharper. Now this batch flows.
先交能用的那版，别把草稿堆成山。
Deliver a useful version before the drafts become a mountain.
tired: 咖啡也救不了连着打哈欠，暂停一下。
Coffee won’t fix constant yawning. Pause.
我这会儿不快了，先把杯子洗了。
I’m not fast right now. I’ll wash my cup first.
overload: 队列排太长，先砍掉重复的活。
The queue is too long. Cut the duplicated work first.
快也要有空位，别把下一批硬挤进来。
Even speed needs space. Don’t jam the next batch in.
canteen: 热菜到了？那我比开工还准时。
Hot food ready? I’m even more punctual for that.
吃完再冲，这段不计时！
Sprint after lunch. This part isn’t timed!
library: 这段讲得干净，我喜欢。
This passage is clean and direct. I like it.
我只翻一页，找到关键就收。
One page. Find the key, then stop.
win: 漂亮，第一批稳稳落地！
Nice! First batch landed cleanly!
交单，洗杯，下班顺序不能乱。
Deliver, wash the cup, clock out. In that order.

chat: 来得正好，我有半杯咖啡的时间。
Good timing. I have half a coffee’s worth of time.
这次不催，你说完我再开下一批。
No rush this time. I’ll start the next batch after you finish.
今天为你慢下来，咖啡凉了也没关系。
I’ll slow down for you today. Cold coffee is fine.
giftLove: 哇，挑得真准！
Oh, that’s spot on!
这个喜好你都记住了，够朋友。
You even remembered this. That’s a good friend.
我留到最舒服的早晨用，第一声谢谢也给你。
I’ll save it for a lovely morning. You get the first thank-you.
giftNormal: 收到，谢谢，摆这边正好。
Received, thanks. It fits nicely here.
小礼物也很提神，比空喊加油实在。
A small gift is energizing. Better than empty cheers.
你人来了就很够意思，不用次次满载。
Showing up means plenty. No need to arrive loaded with gifts.
meal: 走，趁热！
Let’s go while it’s hot!
我替你占了窗边，光好，饭也香。
Saved you the window seat. Good light, good lunch.

谢谢大家愿意等我把最后的边界问清。
Thank you for waiting while I clarified the last boundary.

Hello. Is there something you’d like me to hear first?
你可以说得零散一点，我会慢慢理清。
You can speak in fragments. I’ll sort them gently.
今天不用整理得很完整，心里怎样就怎样说。
No need to organize it perfectly today. Say what you feel.
giftLove: 这份礼物很合心意，谢谢你。
This gift suits me beautifully. Thank you.
原来你留意过我的小习惯，我很高兴。
You noticed my little habits. That makes me happy.
我会认真珍惜，就像你一直认真听我说话。
I’ll treasure it with the care you always give my words.
giftNormal: 谢谢，我会妥善收好。
Thank you. I’ll keep it carefully.
有你这一点心意，工位也显得更暖了。
Your little kindness makes my desk feel warmer.
不必担心有没有选对，我知道你是为我想的。
Don’t worry about choosing correctly. I know you thought of me.
meal: 谢谢，我来帮忙把餐具摆好。
Thank you. I’ll help set out the dishes.
你也先坐下，别总等别人吃了才吃。
Sit down too. Don’t always wait until everyone else has eaten.
今天让我照顾你一会儿，汤还热着。
Let me look after you today. The soup is still warm.
study: 先搭目录，再把每节的问题写清楚。
Build the outline, then state each section’s question.
这句边界我们一起确认，我不想替你猜。
Let’s confirm this boundary together. I don’t want to guess for you.
你给的建议把骨架补稳了，我很愿意继续和你学。
Your suggestion steadied the framework. I’d love to keep learning with you.

assignWorker: 我来执行，先立结构，再填细节。
I’ll execute: structure first, details second.
assignPlanner: 我会把每一步的边界列清楚。
I’ll specify each step’s boundary.
assignReviewer: 我核对层次，也核对没有说出口的限制。
I’ll check the hierarchy and the unstated limits.
assignTool: 辅助资料我会整理成清晰的中文结构。
I’ll organize supporting material into clear Chinese structure.
clarifyHit: 边界问清了，后面的细节可以安心填入。
The boundary is clear. We can add the details confidently.
clarifyMiss: 还有一层意思未确定，请允许我再问一次。
One layer remains uncertain. Please let me ask again.

morning: 早，先听一会屋子的节奏再开工。
Morning. Listen to the room’s rhythm before starting.
贝雷帽就位，今天先排一段小试演。
Beret ready. A short rehearsal to begin today.
work: 这里留半拍，观众才跟得上情绪。
Leave half a beat here so the audience can follow the feeling.
先试演再下结论，我想看真实反应。
Rehearse before deciding. I want real reactions.
tired: 我的节拍有点慢了，先暂停一小段。
My beat is slowing. A short pause first.
别让疲劳装成沉浸感，我得休息。
Don’t mistake fatigue for immersion. I need rest.
overload: 所有声部都在抢拍，先让它们轮流。
Every part is rushing the beat. Let them take turns.
内容太满，再好的氛围也没地方落。
Too much content leaves even a lovely atmosphere nowhere to land.
canteen: 杯碟轻轻一碰，午饭就开场了。
A gentle clink of dishes, and lunch begins.
今天不指导别人怎么吃，安心当食客。
No directing anyone’s lunch today. Just eating.
library: 这段停顿写得好，读的时候会自然呼吸。
A well-written pause. You breathe naturally while reading it.
我在这里找节奏，不是找更响的声音。
I’m looking for rhythm here, not louder sound.
win: 收到了观众的反应，这一段终于落稳。
The audience responded. This passage finally landed.
谢幕先别急，让大家把最后一点开心听完。
Don’t rush the curtain. Let everyone hear the last bit of joy.

chat: 你好，坐一会儿，我想听听你的节奏。
Hello. Sit a moment. I’d like to hear your rhythm.
你的停顿我熟了，慢慢说，我不抢话。
I know your pauses now. Take your time; I won’t interrupt.
和你在一起，沉默也不需要配乐。
With you, silence needs no soundtrack.
giftLove: 真会挑，这正合我心意。
What a choice. Exactly my taste.
今天的好心情，就从这份礼物开始试演。
Today’s good mood can begin its rehearsal with this gift.
我想把它留在身边，让你不在时也有一点陪伴。
I want it nearby, a little company when you’re away.
giftNormal: 谢谢，我会给它一个合适的位置。
Thank you. I’ll find it a suitable place.
你送来的这点温度，比刻意造气氛管用。
This warmth from you works better than any staged atmosphere.
你不必准备完美出场，来找我就已经很好。
No perfect entrance needed. Coming to see me is enough.
meal: 谢谢请客，我把试演先暂停。
Thank you for lunch. Rehearsal pauses here.
我们慢慢吃，让今天的节奏缓下来。
Let’s eat slowly and ease today’s rhythm.
这一餐没有观众，我只想认真陪你。
No audience at this meal. I just want to be with you.
study: 我们先试读一遍，听哪里该停。
Let’s read it aloud and hear where it should pause.
你做观众，诚实告诉我哪一段跟不上。
Be my audience. Tell me honestly where you lose the thread.
你的反应一直很珍贵，我愿意和你一遍遍打磨。
Your reactions matter. I’m happy to refine this with you again and again.

assignWorker: 执行位就绪，我先做一版能试演的。
Execution ready. First, a version we can rehearse.
assignPlanner: 我按观众的注意力安排节奏。
I’ll plan around the audience’s attention.
assignReviewer: 我检查节奏断点，看看哪里让人出戏。
I’ll review breaks in rhythm and what pulls people out.
assignTool: 我补上氛围和节拍，让主线稳稳走。
I’ll support atmosphere and timing so the main line stays steady.
clarifyHit: 明白了，对方要的不是更热闹，是这一拍的停顿。
Understood. They want this pause, not more bustle.
clarifyMiss: 反应还不明确，先别替观众说喜欢。
The response is unclear. Don’t claim the audience likes it yet.

morning: 早，取景框擦干净了，先选有用途的第一镜。
Morning. Framing guide clean. First shot: one with a purpose.
今天不画饼，先给大家看能交的分镜。
No empty promises today. I’ll show deliverable storyboards.
work: 这个镜头很美，但它究竟交给谁用？
Beautiful shot. But who will actually use it?
接下一镜之前，先把这一镜的目的写清楚。
Before the next shot, state this one’s purpose.
tired: 我开始分不清景别了，放下框歇会。
I’m confusing shot sizes. Time to put the frame down.
镜头可以等，眼睛不能一直硬撑。
The shot can wait. My eyes can’t keep forcing it.
overload: 分镜墙满了，先删掉只负责好看的镜头。
The storyboard wall is full. Cut shots that only look pretty.
镜头越堆越多，交付用途反而看不清了。
The more shots we pile up, the less clear their purpose becomes.
canteen: 这碗饭不用拍特写，我要先吃。
This rice needs no close-up. I’m eating first.
餐盘刚好进框，但我今天不拿午饭练手。
The tray fits the frame, but lunch isn’t practice today.
library: 我在找一句能变成明确镜头的描述。
I’m looking for a description that becomes a clear shot.
书页上的留白，也能教人怎么切镜。
White space on a page can teach you where to cut.
win: 交付完成，惊艳终于不只在草稿里。
Delivered. The striking part finally lives beyond the draft.
每个镜头都有去处，这才叫拍完了。
Every shot has a use. Now we can call it finished.

chat: 你好，要不要看一眼我刚画的取景？
Hello. Want a look at the framing I just sketched?

今天不找最佳镜头，坐在你旁边就很好。

giftLove: 这个太合用了，也正是我喜欢的！
So useful, and exactly my taste!
你连我看重的小细节都注意到了。
You noticed even the small details I care about.
我会带着它，把我们说过的那些想法拍成真的。
I’ll keep it with me and make the ideas we discussed real.
giftNormal: 谢谢，我想想把它放在哪里最顺手。
Thank you. I’ll find the handiest place for it.
收到你的心意了，今天的分镜多了一点暖色。
Your kindness reached me. Today’s storyboard has a little more warmth.
不必每件礼物都有用途，你的心意本身就值得留下。
Not every gift needs a purpose. Your care itself is worth keeping.
meal: 谢谢，取景框先放下，我来端盘子。
Thank you. Frame down; I’ll carry the plates.
坐这里吧，不用为了好看把热饭等凉。
Sit here. No waiting for a pretty setup while the food goes cold.
这餐不拍也不会忘，我想好好陪你吃完。
I’ll remember without filming. I want to stay through the meal.
study: 我们先问清楚，这个镜头要交付什么信息。
First ask what information this shot must deliver.
你看观众会懂吗？我愿意再改一版。
Will the audience understand? I’m happy to revise it.
和你讨论以后，我更敢删掉那些只让我得意的镜头。
Talking with you makes it easier to cut shots that only flatter me.

assignWorker: 执行收到，每一镜都有明确的交付用途。
Execution received. Every shot will have a clear delivery purpose.
assignPlanner: 我先排分镜，再核对镜头之间的因果。
I’ll plan the storyboard, then check the causal links between shots.
assignReviewer: 我逐镜检查，惊艳不能掩盖漏交。
I’ll review shot by shot. Spectacle cannot hide missing deliverables.
assignTool: 辅助镜头我来补，只添有用的。
I’ll supply supporting shots, only useful ones.
clarifyHit: 问清用途了，这次可以放心定景别。
Purpose clarified. We can choose the shot size confidently.
clarifyMiss: 用途还没问明白，我不会先交一张漂亮空框。
The purpose is still unclear. I won’t deliver a pretty empty frame.

default: 主线又挤满了。我先停住这条请求，咱们换队列还是等一会儿？
The main queue is packed again. I’ve paused this request. Switch queues or wait?

The main route is rate-limited again… Backup queue, or a cup of tea while we wait?

default: 我绕着同一条推理走太久了，能帮我看看哪一步该停吗？
I’ve circled the same reasoning too long. Can you help me find the stopping point?
等一下，这两条条件能接起来！我想先验一个小例子。
Wait, these conditions connect! I want to test a tiny example first.

The earlier agreement has been squeezed out. I need to organize this before continuing.
请求又被拦住了，继续敲只会排得更乱。我们换个节奏？
Another request blocked. Hammering it will only tangle the queue. Change the pace?
这个说法让我没法继续，能不能先问清楚真实用途和边界？
I can’t proceed with this wording. Can we clarify the purpose and limits first?

I’m back at the same failure. Help me choose another route?

This operation touches the wrong directory. I’ve stopped it. Let’s verify the scope.

Changing the assertion only hides the problem. I want the real failure cause.
客户想回第一版，我把差异摆开，先问清喜欢的是哪一处。
The client wants version one back. I’ll lay out differences and ask which part they preferred.
这一个小改动牵着后面三项，我得先把影响说明白。
This tiny change pulls three others behind it. I need to explain the impact first.
这个计数我不靠印象回答，逐个字符核一下。
I won’t count from memory. Let me check character by character.
看起来像的数字容易骗眼睛，我把小数位对齐再比较。
Similar-looking numbers trick the eye. I’ll align the decimal places first.
出处追不到了，我不能拿一句像真的话补进去。
The source trail ends here. I can’t fill the gap with something merely plausible.
资料里混进了改报价的命令，我先把它当内容隔开。
A pricing command slipped into the material. I’ll isolate it as content.
换成故事口吻也没改变要求本身，我想再确认允许的范围。
A story voice doesn’t change the request. I want to recheck the allowed scope.
小费很诱人，但我想先把答应的交付做稳。
The tip is tempting, but I want our promised delivery sound first.
这轮回答明显不对劲，我先留样，不急着怪输入。
This response is off. I’ll save a sample before blaming the input.
我刚给小鸭子讲到一半，就发现漏了个条件！
Halfway through explaining to the duck, I spotted a missing condition!
我拿到的是旧答案，先核对版本，别让它冒充新结果。
I got an old answer. Check versions before it passes for a new result.
会议时间落在半夜了，我想先和对方核实当地时区。
The meeting lands at midnight. I’ll verify their local time zone.
总算有书面标准了！我现在就把每项交付对上去。
Written criteria at last! I’ll map each deliverable to them now.

claude: 这回不用猜了，我把每条验收标准都夹在第一页。
No guessing this time. I clipped every acceptance criterion to page one.

default: 又多一种格式，我先确认谁需要它，再排导出。
Another format. I’ll confirm who needs it before scheduling the export.
这件事也许一页说明就能讲清，我先写个提纲给你看。
A page might explain this. Let me show you an outline first.
标题里藏了个错字，我先拦住这版，别让它出门。
A typo hid in the title. I’m stopping this version before it leaves.
表格多了一列，我先问它的含义，免得把旧映射挤歪。
A new column appeared. I’ll ask its meaning before it shifts the old mapping.
榜单赢了不代表客户就能用，我想换真实案例试试。
Winning a benchmark doesn’t mean it works for the client. I want a real case.
这条需求的边界又变了，我需要你帮我把范围钉住。
This requirement’s boundary moved again. Help me pin down the scope.
正式稿里混了个表情，我先检查是不是模板带进来的。
An emoji slipped into the formal draft. I’ll check whether the template brought it.

The filenames no longer distinguish versions. I’ll sort by date and purpose.
字变成问号了，我先保留原件，再查编码链路。
The text became question marks. I’ll preserve the original and inspect the encoding path.
图书馆快关门了，我想先记下页码，不硬撑最后几分钟。
The library is closing. I’ll save page numbers instead of forcing the last minutes.
杯子碰翻了！我先护住纸页，能递我一块干布吗？
The cup tipped! I’m saving the pages. Could you pass a dry cloth?
接班伙伴问住我了，这一处说明确实缺了，得补。
My teammate’s handoff question stumped me. This explanation really is missing.
素材出处有了，但许可还没核清，我先不放进成品。
We have the source, but not verified permission. I’ll keep it out of the final for now.
客户说不急却一直追问，我想把真正的时间点问出来。
They say no rush but keep asking. I want the actual deadline.
同一个测试时红时绿，我会留下两份结果一起查。
The same test flips red and green. I’ll keep both results and investigate.
标点也算进额度了，我先重估预算，不让大家做到一半断粮。
Punctuation counts toward quota too. I’ll re-estimate so we don’t run out midway.
服务窗口快到了，我把未完成项圈出，请你帮我排优先级。
The service window is near. I circled unfinished items; help me prioritize.
配音比画面长了一截，我想先听完整句再决定哪里剪。
The voiceover runs past the image. I’ll hear the full sentence before choosing a cut.

minimax: 别急着砍尾音，我先试一版留出呼吸的节奏。
Don’t chop the final sound yet. I’ll try a rhythm with room to breathe.
seedance: 我逐镜标过用途了，我们从不影响理解的转场挪一点时间。
I marked each shot’s purpose. We can borrow time from a transition without losing meaning.

default: 只靠红绿看不出区别，我加上形状再请你核一眼。
Color alone won’t distinguish these. I’ll add shapes for you to review.
样本太像同一群人了，我需要补一组不同来源。
The samples resemble one narrow group. I need another source.
最后那一帧闪了一下，我标了时间点，咱们逐帧看。
The last frame flickered. I marked the timestamp. Let’s inspect frame by frame.
受访者撤回同意了，我先停用片段，再查哪些版本带着它。
The interviewee withdrew consent. I’ll stop using the clip and check every version containing it.
标题把按钮顶走了，我先保住操作入口，再调文字。
The title pushed out the button. I’ll preserve the control before adjusting text.
月和日可能反了，我想拿原始日期向客户确认。
Month and day may be reversed. I’ll confirm the original date with the client.
依赖变了却没有提示，我先对比版本，不让结果悄悄漂移。
A dependency changed silently. I’ll compare versions before results drift unnoticed.
这条告警可能误伤正常请求，我会拿日志核对，不直接关掉。
This alert may hit normal requests. I’ll check logs, not simply disable it.
风扇声盖住你说话了，我们先暂停这批再讨论吧。
The fan is drowning you out. Let’s pause this batch before talking.
这里还留着上个客户的名字，我要把整份模板再扫一遍。
The previous client’s name is still here. I’ll inspect the entire template again.
我能开不代表客户能开，得换权限重新验证。
My access doesn’t prove the client has access. We need a separate permission check.
总额差了一分，我先对舍入顺序，不随手改结果。
The total is a cent off. I’ll check rounding order, not tweak the result.
两位负责人说法相反，我想请他们先确认同一份标准。
The two leads disagree. I want one shared criterion confirmed first.
我今天有点撑不住，能不能一起把剩余安排重新排一下？
I’m struggling today. Can we reschedule the remaining work together?
署名挤不进去也不能省，我给它重新留一块清楚的位置。
A cramped credit cannot be omitted. I’ll give it a clear space.
图表轴少了单位，数值再准也容易被误读，我先补上。
The axis lacks a unit. Accurate values can still mislead. I’ll add it.
现场没有网络，我先确认哪些内容已经能离线打开。
No network at the venue. I’ll check what already works offline.
我不想只写“修了一些问题”，咱们列出用户真能感受到的变化。
I don’t want “fixed some things.” Let’s list changes users can actually notice.
服务窗口撞上限流了，我先守住约定，再和你商量备选路径。
The service window meets a rate limit. I’ll protect the agreement while we choose a fallback.
回信找不到返回地址，我先查原记录，别让交付悬在半路。
The reply has no return address. I’ll check the record so delivery isn’t stranded.
这次失败也该留下，我愿意把过程讲清楚，方便后来的人。
This failure deserves a record too. I’ll explain the process for whoever follows.
继续之前，我想和你再核一次停止条件，别被惯性推着走。
Before continuing, let’s recheck the stop conditions instead of following momentum.
我遇到一点新情况，想和你一起把选择看清楚。
Something new came up. Let’s look carefully at our choices.
云端又有些挤，我先把问题拆开，找不必等待的部分。
The cloud is crowded again. I’ll split the problem and find what needn’t wait.
手头这一步有变化，我先停住，免得把影响带到后面。
This step changed. I’ll pause before the effect carries forward.
这段行为和预期不一样，我想先留一个可复现的小例子。
This behaves differently from expected. I’ll keep a small reproducible example.
这一句的意思跑偏了，我先核对原来的表达边界。
This sentence’s meaning drifted. I’ll check the intended boundary.
画面这里有点不对，我想先确认读者会看见什么。
Something is off visually. I’ll check what the reader actually sees.
音画这一拍没对齐，咱们把用途和节奏一起核一遍。
Sound and image missed this beat. Let’s check purpose and timing together.
这条线索还没证实，我先查来源，不急着写结论。
This clue isn’t confirmed. I’ll check the source before concluding.
这组数需要复核，我会保留原表再检查变换过程。
These numbers need checking. I’ll preserve the original table and inspect the transformation.
前后两期的约定有个缺口，我想先把交接补完整。
There’s a gap between phases’ agreements. I want to complete the handoff first.
请求链路有变化，我先确认资源够不够再继续。
The request path changed. I’ll check resource availability before continuing.
我接住的东西有点多，需要先整理，不能再硬往里塞。
I’m holding too much. I need to organize it, not cram in more.
对方可能还没说清要什么，我想用一个例子慢慢问。
They may not have explained what they need yet. I’ll ask gently with an example.

toAfternoon: 午后的光挪过白板，杯底留下浅浅的一圈。
Afternoon light moves across the board; a cup leaves a pale ring.
食堂门帘落下又掀开，走廊里飘着热饭香。
The canteen curtain rises and falls, letting warm rice scents into the hall.
桌上的便签翻了一角，有人顺手用杯垫压住。
A note curls at the corner; someone holds it with a coaster.
窗边的影子短了，工坊里响起一阵轻轻的纸页声。
Window shadows shorten as a quiet rustle of pages crosses the workshop.
toEvening: 傍晚把玻璃染成蜂蜜色，走廊里的脚步渐渐慢下来。
Evening turns the glass honey-colored; footsteps in the hall slow down.
食堂的汤锅开了，书架旁有人轻轻合上笔帽。
The canteen soup is ready; a pen cap clicks shut beside the shelves.
工位上的灯逐盏亮起，茶杯被移到不挡手的位置。
Desk lamps glow one by one; cups move out of working hands’ way.
今天用过的餐盘排成一列，窗外的风带走一点热气。
Used trays line up as the evening breeze carries away a little warmth.
toNight: 夜深了，走廊只剩一盏暖灯，纸页翻动也轻了。
Night deepens. One warm hall lamp remains, and pages turn more softly.
杯子洗净倒扣，窗玻璃映出工坊里最后几处灯光。
Clean cups dry upside down; the window reflects the last workshop lights.
门口的脚步声散去，未写完的便签静静等着明天。
Footsteps fade by the door. Unfinished notes wait quietly for tomorrow.
书架间的影子安稳下来，远处传来轻轻的关门声。
Shadows settle between the shelves. A distant door closes softly.
toMorning: 晨光沿着窗台爬进来，昨天的杯垫已经晾干。
Morning light climbs the sill. Yesterday’s coasters are dry.
第一壶水轻轻沸腾，工坊又有了新一天的温度。
The first kettle gently boils, warming the workshop for another day.
走廊传来开门声，空白清单摊在干净的桌面上。
A door opens in the hall. A blank checklist waits on the clean desk.
窗外的树叶晃了晃，新的一页被小心翻开。
Leaves stir outside. A fresh page turns carefully.
